text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Right after Shinatsu and Aira met up with {0} and the others...
text_block_list.orig_text:
シナツとアイラの二人が
{0}たちと合流した直後のこと……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should we eat?
You guys should decide what to eat while you still can!
Go ahead and order everything your heart desires♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ～て、
何を食べようかな？
みんなも今のうちに食べる物を決めておいてね！
もうなんでも注文しちゃっていいから♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Is that alright?
text_block_list.orig_text: いいんですか？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's fine, really!
After all, your big sister got her pay from beating up monsters♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
遠慮なんてしないしない！
なにせお姉さんには
魔物退治の賞金があるからね♪

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: A reward from slaying monsters... I see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物退治の賞金……
なるほど。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
...Aira.
Don't get carried away.
What if you end up running out of funds?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アイラ。
あまり大口を叩くな。
残金が足りなかったらどうする。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, it's okay!
If push comes to shove, I can just wash the dishes or something!
Besides...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫大丈夫！
いざとなったら皿洗いでもなんでもすればいいし！
それに……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: As long as Shinatsu-chan doesn't drink too much, right?♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
シナツちゃんが飲みすぎなければ、
ねっ♪

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
As long as she doesn't drink too much...?
What do you mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
飲みすぎなければ……？
何をですか？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, are you curious?
Well, to tell the truth~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
気になる？
実はね～……

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Aira...
Wait, that's enough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイラ……
待て、
そこまでに──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text: かんぱーい！

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...Cheers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
乾杯。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: *gulp gulp*... Pwah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごくごくごく……
ぷはーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ah~ That hits the spot~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
染みるぅ～～～♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're quite the drinker.
Here you are: Two chicken skewers, thanks for waiting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
いい飲みっぷりだね。
はいよ、
鶏肉の串焼き二人前、
お待ち。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Here at last♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！
待ってました♪

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...Hello.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……どうも。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
You're quite the skilled customer, aren't you?
You got rid of those monsters in no time at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしお客さん、
本当に腕が立つんだね。
魔物を
あっ
という間に倒しちまうなんてさ。

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer 2
text_block_list.text:
For real!
I was surprised by how red the sky got, but she shocked me to my core!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当だよ！
空が赤くなってるのにも驚いたけど
それよりも驚いたぜ！

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer 1
text_block_list.text: As if that wasn't enough, my gut tells me her companion is a real beauty...
text_block_list.orig_text: おまけにお連れさんもすっげぇ美人な予感が……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
But if you keep staring, your barley will turn lukewarm, you know~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう！
でも、
あんまりこっちを見てると、
麦しゅわがぬるくなっちゃうよ～？

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer 3
text_block_list.text:
The lady has a point.
Let's leave it at that, you two.
I apologize on their behalf, please take your time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉さんの言う通りだよ。
二人とも、それくらいにしておきな。
ごめんなさいね、
どうぞごゆっくり。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thank you very much~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
どうもどうも～♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
...So, Shinatsu-chan.
I don't think you'll be able to eat or drink anything if you keep your mask on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……で、シナツちゃん。
マスクしたままだったら、
何も食べたり飲んだりできないと思うけど？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
...It's very crowded here.
I've never shown my face in these circumstances.
text_block_list.orig_text:
…………人が多い場所で。
素顔を晒すことがなかったものでな。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: I need to... prepare myself mentally.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少し……
心の準備が要る。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I forgot there's a limit to how much you can go out in public.
You're pretty much cooped up in Sol Tower, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
人前に出るタイミングって限られちゃうよね。
基本
ソルの塔に閉じこもってるわけだし？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
How do you remain so calm, Aira?
...Does nothing faze you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイラはなぜ平気なんだ？
……緊張しないのか。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much♪ In my world, I'm known as a pretty friendly god.
When I do show up in front of everyone, it's usually for a festival or something along those lines.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん♪
一応あたしの世界では、
フレンドリーなカミサマで通ってるからね。
みんなの前に出るときも
基本はお祭りとかのタイミングだし？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
I see...
That's in stark contrast to my world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか……
私のところとは
随分違うな。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
...When I go outside, it's during times of trial and tribulation.
I give everyone advice and assignments so they may overcome their hardships.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私が表に出るときは
試練の時だ。
皆が苦境を乗り越えるための
助言や課題を与える。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, just like a god would♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
カミサマっぽーい♪

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
But, well, here we're just ordinary nobodies.
So there's nothing wrong with loosening up, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもまあ、
こっちにいるときは
『ごく普通の一般人』だし。
もうちょっと肩の力を抜いてもいいんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
If you're ever worried about how others see you, I'll be here for you.
Okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りの視線が気になったときは、
あたしがガードしてあげるからさ。
ねっ？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
...Don't speak as if you're my senior.
Your source is younger than mine, is it not?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……まるで年上のようなことを言うな。
『元』は私より年下だろう。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, don't worry!
Just leave everything to your big sister! Just kidding♪
Ahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にしない気にしない！
お姉さんに任せなさーい！　
なんてね♪
あはははは！

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふふ。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... these are all delicious.
Especially this stew. It has a very deep flavor...
The richness is nothing short of addicting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ……
どれも美味だな。
特にこの煮込み。
非常に奥深い味わいだ……
濃厚さがクセになる。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
It's so delicious~!
Let's have seconds.
Want another tankard of barley? Is a large okay with you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいよね～！
それ、
おかわりしよっか。
麦しゅわももう一杯いっとく？　
大ジョッキでいい？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: Yeah, large.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
大で。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nicely put♪
Master! Two large tankards of barley!
And a refill of that stew, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
いけるクチだね♪
マ
スター！
麦しゅわ大ジョッキで二つ！　
あと煮込みのおかわりお願いしまーす！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Coming right up!
text_block_list.orig_text: はいよー！

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Anyway... this barley.
It's really good, but it's a little different from back home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても……
こっちの麦しゅわ。
おいしいけど、
な～んかあたしのとこと違うなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: Different in what way?
text_block_list.orig_text: どう違うんだ？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
This is much more red.
But it's kind of quirky, isn't it?
If you get hooked on it, it's pretty...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっと赤いんだよ。
ちょっとクセはあるんだけどね？
ハマったらこれがなかなか……♪

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I suppose there really are differences between worlds...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ。
やはり世界の違いか……

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
If we're in different worlds, we'll have different barley, too.
And while we're at it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界が違えば麦しゅわも違うってことだね～
ついでに言えば……

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: A different administrator, too... Right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
管理者も違う……
だな。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
text_block_list.orig_text: だね。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what kind of girl she is.
The administrator of this world, I mean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どんな子なのかな。
こっちの世界の管理者って。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Considering that we're here right now, it's most likely to be Yui's 'copy'.
Of course, it could always be someone else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちが今この場にいることを考えれば……
最も可能性が高いのは、
ユイの『複製』だろう。
もちろん別の誰かかもしれないが。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea just how many other duplicate worlds there are.
*sigh* Just thinking about it makes me faint.
text_block_list.orig_text:
他にいくつ『複製の世界』があるか、
分かんないもんね。
はぁ～
考えるだけで気が遠くなるよ。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Well, whatever the case, it'd be nice if we could get along with the Hiyori-chan and co. from this world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
なんにしてもさ。
こっちの世界のヒヨリちゃんたちと仲良くできたらいいよね。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is just using their data.
We're the ones who created our own world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなはデータを利用されただけ。
あたしたちの世界を作ってきたのは
あたしたち自身なんだからさ。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
……そうだな。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Two large mugs of barley, right here.
And a refill of stew.
text_block_list.orig_text:
麦しゅわ大ジョッキ二つ、
お待ち。
あと煮込みね。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: Much appreciated.
text_block_list.orig_text: 助かる。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ah right, Master.
Would you happen to know if there's more red-colored barley around here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
マスター
この辺りにさ、
もっと
赤い色の麦しゅわってない？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Red-colored... ah, red barley.
It's not from here, but I'm pretty sure you can get more of it if you go to western regions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
赤い色……
ああ、
赤麦しゅわか。
この辺りにはないが、
確か西の地方に行けば飲めるはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
West...
That's where I ended up upon breaking in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
西……
私が侵入時にいた辺りか。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Breaking in?
text_block_list.orig_text: 侵入？

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, listen here!
Thank you, Master, I've got some good information!♪
Shinatsu-chan, we'll head west tomorrow──
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
こっちの話！
マスターありがとう、
いい情報が手に入ったよー♪
シナツちゃん、
明日にでも西に──

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Whew.
Another tankard of barley. Large.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう。
麦しゅわ、
もう一杯。
大で。

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text: Ain'tcha drinking too fast!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 飲むの早っ！？

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text:
Aira.
Leave it at that.
If you recall anything further──
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイラ。
それくらいにしておけ。
それ以上、
思い出すのなら──

text_block_list.name: Aira
text_block_list.text:
I-I get it!
I won't say anything!
Just don't draw your sword!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かったよ！
言わない言わないっ！
だから剣は抜かないで～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You two... seem to get along pretty well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか……
仲いいんだね。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……そうだね。
